item.title: Worldview Weekly — October 29, 2026
item.description: Welcome to Worldview Weekly, a global analytical complement to The Economist. This week, we ask who gets to make the rules, and how those rules distribute the gains and risks of a connected world. Our twelve readings range from trade platforms and oil markets to the high seas, military alliances, artificial intelligence and a small-town art museum in China. The point is not to collect twelve opinions or to disagree with a familiar publication on principle. It is to find explanations that reveal something a headline can miss.
